units.source_text: 此诗虽非特异之佳作，但玉鬘看了冷泉帝容貌姿态之优美，自然觉得富有情趣。

en.t: Though this poem was not an especially remarkable masterpiece, after Tamakazura saw the elegance of Emperor Reizei's looks and bearing, she naturally found it full of charm.

units.source_text: 他吟罢又说：“我想‘为爱春郊宿一宵’，

en.t: After he finished reciting it, he said again, "I would like to 'spend one night in the spring fields for love,'

units.source_text: 但念有人舍不得你，其心比我更苦，所以放你回去吧。

en.t: but when I think that there is someone who cannot bear to part with you, and whose heart suffers even more than mine, I will let you go back.

units.source_text: 此后我们如何互通音信呢？”

en.t: How shall we exchange messages with each other from now on?"
As he spoke, he was overcome with sorrow and distress.
